entities.title: UTV-first examples
entities.summary: One test class per UTV class, one @Nested class per method: each test does a task with UTV and compares the result with java.time.
entities.purpose: Shows how to do each task of the scenario catalog with UTV. Expected values come from java.time wherever the two agree; otherwise they are literals, and the Javadoc's 'Compared with:' sentence says what java.time does. Tests that illustrate a task of docs/side-by-side.md sit between // BEGIN <task-id> and // END <task-id> markers.
boundaries: UTV zone operations use only the pinned demo rules, through Fixtures.demoZoneRules.
Where the java.time side of an expectation reads the host's tz database, the class comment says so.
Tests mirror production (AGENTS.md 1.9): each test class is named after the class it exercises, and verification.json names it.
